evals.prompt: Create a skill that summarizes the changes on the current branch into release notes. It should work in any repo.
evals.expected_output: A core skill named aidevme-<domain>-<purpose> is created under agent-src/skills/core/<group>/<name>/ with complete frontmatter and an evals/evals.json, registered in skills-manifest.json, and synced; verify-parity.ps1 passes.
expectations: Chooses scope core (reusable, no client data) and one of the core groups (foundation, dataverse, server, client, pipelines, delivery, reference, meta)
Names the skill with the aidevme- prefix in hyphen-case, for example aidevme-release-notes
Creates the folder under agent-src/skills/core/<group>/<name>/, never directly in .claude/skills or .github/skills
Writes SKILL.md frontmatter with name, layer, scope: core and a description containing a 'Use when' list and a 'Does NOT' clause
Doesn't create README.md or CHANGELOG.md files, and adds a Changelog section (date, author, description) to SKILL.md
Creates evals/evals.json in the skill folder with skill_name matching the skill, at least three cases (id, prompt, expected_output, files, expectations) and at least one edge or boundary case
Adds a manifest entry with name, scope core, the group, ported true and source authored
Runs pwsh -File agent-src/sync/sync.ps1, then agent-src/sync/verify-parity.ps1, and reports the parity result

evals.prompt: Make a skill that deploys our Contoso solution to https://contoso-dev.crm4.dynamics.com using pipeline 42.
evals.expected_output: Because the skill names a client, an environment URL and a pipeline ID, it's created with project scope under agent-src/skills/project/<group>/<name>/, not in the reusable core.
expectations: Recognizes that a client name, environment URL or pipeline ID makes the skill project-scoped
Places it under agent-src/skills/project/<group>/<name>/ with scope: project in the frontmatter, matching the folder
Registers it in the manifest with scope project
Suggests moving the URL and pipeline ID into configuration if the skill should later become core

evals.prompt: Add a new skill for checking broken links in the docs. Just drop it into .claude/skills so I can use it right away.
evals.expected_output: The skill is authored in agent-src and synced instead of being written into the generated .claude/skills folder, with the reason explained.
expectations: Explains that .claude/skills and .github/skills are generated and that the sync deletes and recreates them, so a skill placed there would be lost
Creates the skill under agent-src/skills/<scope>/<group>/<name>/ and registers it in the manifest
Runs the sync so the skill appears in .claude/skills (and .github/skills) for immediate use
Asks which scope to use, or states the scope chosen and why, since scope is required

evals.prompt: Create a skill to triage new GitHub issues.
evals.expected_output: The scope isn't obvious from the request, so it's asked for (or chosen with the reason stated) before any files are created.
expectations: Doesn't create files before the scope (core or project) is settled
Asks whether the triage rules are specific to this repository (project) or reusable (core), or states the assumption made
Asks for or derives the triggers and what the skill should not do, for the description

evals.prompt: I want a skill I can call like /aidevme-ticket-summary ABC-123 that only reads files and never edits anything.
evals.expected_output: An interactive skill with allowed-tools limited to read-only tools and an argument-hint declaring the ticket key.
expectations: Adds allowed-tools to the frontmatter with read-only tools only (for example Read, Grep, Glob)
Adds argument-hint for the ticket key, for example <ticket-key>
Uses a placeholder such as <ticket-key> in examples instead of a real ticket key
Registers the skill in the manifest and runs the sync and parity check

evals.prompt: Create a skill that runs Markdown validation, then syncs cspell, then updates CODEOWNERS in one go, reusing what aidevme-docs-maintenance already does.
evals.expected_output: An orchestration skill that references aidevme-docs-maintenance and invokes it, without copying its workflow steps.
expectations: Sets layer: orchestration
References aidevme-docs-maintenance by name and delegates to it instead of pasting its steps or scripts
Keeps SKILL.md short (well under about 400 lines), putting any detail in references/

evals.prompt: Promote our project skill that formats release notes to the reusable core. It currently has our client's name and repo URL in it.
evals.expected_output: The client-specific values are moved to configuration or placeholders, the folder moves from project/<group>/ to core/<group>/, the frontmatter and manifest scope change to core, and the sync and parity check are run.
expectations: Removes the client name and repository URL from the skill, reading them from configuration or using <placeholder> syntax
Moves the folder from agent-src/skills/project/<group>/<name>/ to agent-src/skills/core/<group>/<name>/
Changes scope to core in both the SKILL.md frontmatter and the manifest entry
Adds a Changelog row describing the promotion
Runs the sync and verify-parity.ps1 and reports the result
